# Code Anchors: Page Frames

- `src/app/FramedLayout.tsx` — the frame for pages with the main navigation
- `src/app/BottomNav.tsx` — the main navigation, the menu panel and the marked area
- `src/app/area.ts` — works the marked area out from the start of the path
- `src/app/routes.tsx` — places each page in the framed or the full-screen frame
- `src/pages/PageHeader.tsx` — the shared header of a framed page
- `src/app/navigation.test.tsx` — tests the navigation entries, the menu and the marked area
- `docs/system/design-system.md` — design-system rule naming the pages that show no bottom navigation
